units.source_text: 那天是停电的日子，我和鹤川一起到南禅寺去。

en.t: That day was a power outage day, and Tsurukawa and I went together to Nanzenji Temple.

units.source_text: 我们还没有拜访过南弹寺。

en.t: We had not yet visited Nandanji Temple.

units.source_text: 我们横穿过宽阔的公路，走过了架有坡道京车的木桥。

en.t: We crossed the wide road and walked over a wooden bridge that had a sloping Kyoto-style cart track built onto it.
